name: power clean thruster
description: A power clean flowing straight into a front squat and overhead press. It is a big full-body power movement.
instructions: Set up with the barbell over mid-foot and grip it just outside your knees.
Pull the bar explosively and catch it on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand, then sink into a full front squat.
Drive up and press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and then to the floor with control.
